title: Workers Not Processing Any Webhook Queue

posts.name: Raghavendra Pratap Singh
posts.cooked:
Hello, I’m having trouble getting any web-hooks to fire on my self-hosted Docker installation.

Symptoms:

  1. When I update a document (like ToDo or Attendance Request), the Webhook Request Log remains completely empty.

  2. I have confirmed my webhook configuration is correct (JSON body, no condition, on_update event).

  3. I have tested with a public URL from webhook.site and it receives nothing.

Diagnostics I’ve run:

  1. I have checked the Redis queues using redis-cli (LLEN “queue:short”) immediately after triggering an event, and the queues are always at 0. This means the job is not being enqueued.

  2. I have run docker-compose down and docker-compose up -d for a full restart.

  3. I have run bench --site all clear-cache and bench --site all enable-scheduler inside the container.

  4. The main website is working fine, so the database and web processes are healthy.

This seems to indicate a problem with the process that enqueues background jobs. Can anyone suggest what to check next? My worker logs are not showing any obvious connection errors after the restart.
